purpose: Frozen pre-ID-compression baseline. Compare future lossless ID compression primarily against the uncompressed u64 cases; retain u32 cases for context.

accounting.payload: Live full-vector, neighbor-list, and quantized-vector ValueBytes, including the reserved start point, unused neighbor capacity, and trailing count slots.
accounting.other_sizes: Full per-term key, inline allocation, heap, metadata, ID-map and start-point accounting is retained in each full_storage_census; allocated live-record totals are reported separately from payload and process RSS.

parameters.historical_scope_note: Selected actual Garnet NOQUANT profiles used cosine and different query/split preparation; construction/search constants are inherited, not historical recall or QPS. Q8 uses the same fixed constants without claiming a previously selected Q8 winner.
parameters.query_repetition_scope: Three timed repetitions per workload on each of three fresh graph builds; medians across nine samples per workload. Alternating baseline/updated build order between ingest repetitions.
parameters.ingest_pipeline_reason: Retain one-command ingest batches for both ID widths after the stock 500 ms deadline rejected a pipeline-25 Wikipedia batch. The remaining runs use the approved optional timeout flag, without changing pipeline size or graph/search parameters.
parameters.response_timeout_scope: Applies to remaining runs made with the optional-timeout client. The first 14 completed builds used the original client with its unchanged 500 ms default; their exact commands and results are retained.

historical_recall_target.scope: Selected actual Garnet NOQUANT profiles used cosine and different query/split preparation; construction/search constants are inherited, not historical recall or QPS. Q8 uses the same fixed constants without claiming a previously selected Q8 winner.

future_comparison_conditions: Use the uncompressed u64 cases as the direct ID-compression reference, not the u32 cases.

Keep dataset and ground-truth hashes, distance metric, vector retention, M, construction/search EF, returned-neighbor count, task/pipeline workloads and CPU affinity explicit and matched; document any change.
Report achieved recall alongside QPS. The historical 98% target is not a claim that these fixed-parameter baseline runs met it.
Compare value payload, allocated live records and process memory as separate quantities. Checkpoint file lengths are not a live graph/vector size measure.
Preserve this baseline unchanged and record compressed results separately.

full_storage_census.accounting: Live stored ValueSpan lengths; keys, extended namespaces, inline record layout and CalculateHeapMemorySize reported separately. Includes unused neighbor capacity and configured start point. Excludes hash allocation, obsolete records, page slack and checkpoint duplication.

ingest_build_time.definition: Client-reported vector ingestion plus index construction, not isolated native build CPU time. Process wall time includes client startup and setup.

recall.note: The historical target used cosine workloads with different query/split preparation. These runs hold parameters fixed, use the recorded metrics and data, and do not enforce or retune to that historical threshold.

provenance.client: Original unmodified vectorset release binary for the first 14 completed builds; optional response-timeout flag added with approval for all remaining builds. No dependency changes.

original_client.completed_builds: All twelve Wikipedia builds and the baseline/updated OpenAI NOQUANT repetition-one pair

provenance.checkpoint_device_reason: Default allocation failed index checkpoint I/O with Native (error4) and RandomAccess (EIO). RandomAccess with native allocation produced a successful updated checkpoint; both variants and offline reads use those same settings. Timed runs remain in-memory with AOF disabled.
provenance.ingest_load_control: 32 tasks, pipeline size 1 for both variants throughout. Graph/search parameters and dependencies unchanged. Pipeline-25 Wikipedia and pipeline-1 OpenAI timeout attempts are preserved under failed-attempts and excluded from successful timing samples.
provenance.storage_census: Existing distinct-key iterator, cross-checked against complete external-member enumeration, bijective ID maps and direct reads of every vector/graph term. Snapshot lookup scan overcounted 21 Q8 record versions; assertions were not relaxed.
provenance.checkpoint_retention: Preserve the first four-byte-ID checkpoint for each dataset/mode with binaries, measured JSON, exact commands and raw client logs. Use private recovery copies; remove only experiment-owned temporary copies and updated checkpoints after measurement. Other ingest repetitions remain fresh in-memory runs.

benchmark_matrix.deadline_policy: Original client for 14 builds; approved optional response-timeout flag for the remaining 10. Every baseline/updated repetition pair used the same deadline. Failed attempts are retained separately.
